meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门平台，掌握短篇网文爆款题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速知道最近什么题材受欢迎
copy.tagline_en: Scan top platforms to spot viral short-story topics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short fiction and need to know what's trending.

howto.what: 它变成短篇网文市场分析师:抓取或读取知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台的榜单数据,产出扫榜报告,含情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警和值得写的方向。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜,或说「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」等话时会触发,先确认平台和方向。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言故事最近的榜单,看什么题材火
say.note: 会先问平台和方向,再出扫榜报告

say.text: 七猫短篇现在哪类情绪最吃香?
say.note: 输出该平台的情绪热度排行与题材热点

say.text: 对比一下点众和黑岩的短篇热门方向

howto.what_en: It acts as a short-form web-fiction market analyst, reading ranking data from platforms like Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan and Dianzhong, then producing a scan report: emotion heat rankings, trending genres, windfall alerts and directions worth writing.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /story-short-scan, /短篇扫榜, or asking what short stories are trending, e.g. "短篇什么火". It first confirms platform and direction.

say_en.text: Scan Zhihu Yanyan's recent rankings and tell me which genres are hot
say_en.note: Asks platform/direction first, then outputs a report

say_en.text: Which emotion types work best on Qimao short stories now?
say_en.note: Gives emotion heat and genre hotspots

say_en.text: Compare trending short-story directions on Dianzhong and Heiyan
